verses.1: And after they had dwelt there, their children multiplied; and those among them who glorified God and honored Him did not transgress His commandment.
verses.2: And there were also prophets who prophesied of what had been and of what would be; and there were among the children of sinners those who did evil and provoked Him, like Cain the firstborn, who was born to Adam and who killed his brother Abel.

verses.5: And Abel was righteous, but Cain was a sinner, because he killed his brother Abel the righteous.
verses.6: And again Seth the righteous was born, for Adam begot
verses.7: And among them there were prophets and righteous ones, and among them there were sinners and transgressors.
verses.8: And among them there were good and blessed ones who did the will of their father Adam and all that he commanded Seth his son, from Adam until Noah the righteous, who kept the commandment of God.
verses.9: And he also admonished them and told his children the will of God; and they likewise told their children and admonished them concerning the will of God, as their father Noah had told them, that they should not transgress the commandment of God.
verses.10: And they likewise continued teaching those who came after them, their children.
verses.11: But Satan, while he fought against those who said and spoke to them among the idols at the tombs of their fathers, in the form of an image, made them do all that he, the teacher of evil, commanded them.
verses.12: And they worshipped idols according to their customs, until the time when Abraham the righteous arose, who did the will of God.
verses.13: And the covenant of God was established with him by fire and by a covenant, because he was the first to walk in the way of righteousness, apart from his kindred.
verses.14: And God swore to him that He would give him the land as an inheritance, to him and to his seed forever.
verses.15: And likewise with Isaac He established it, to give him the inheritance of his father Abraham; and with Jacob also He likewise established it, to give him the inheritance of Isaac his father.
verses.16: And their seed after them, the children of Jacob, He appointed as kings and priests from among the people of Israel, and He blessed them and said to them, 'Multiply and increase greatly.'
verses.17: And He gave them the inheritance of their fathers, and they did not forsake the worship of God, while He watched over them and loved them in everything.
verses.18: And when their enemies sought to kill them, they were afflicted and cried out to God, because God loved them and had mercy on them.
verses.19: And it was not for their own sake, but for the sake of their fathers, for He is merciful and forgiving to all that He has created.
verses.20: And He stretches out His right hand in blessing, that He may satisfy the hungry soul, and He opens His eyes in mercy, and that He may multiply food for the thirsty.
verses.21: And He gives drink to the young of the ravens and to all who call upon Him; and for the children of Israel also He saved them from the hand of their enemy and their adversaries when they cried out to Him.
verses.22: And again they turned to worship Him, and He sent against them nations and their enemies who surrounded them, and He destroyed them and killed them and delivered them up.
verses.23: And again they cried out to God with weeping and with groaning, and He sent them help; at times He saved them by the hand of prophets.
verses.24: And at times He saved them by the hand of judges; and when they worshipped God, He made their enemies serve them and subdued them, and they were not defeated.
verses.25: And David arose and saved them from the hand of the Philistines; and again they worshipped God, and He sent against them those who oppressed them.
verses.26: And at times He saved them by the hand of Jephthah; and again they sinned against God who had saved them, and He sent against them evil enemies who afflicted them and delivered them up and subdued them, because God had forsaken them.
verses.27: And again they cried out to Him when they were oppressed, and He saved them by the hand of Gideon; and again they worshipped God with the work of their hands.
verses.28: And He also sent against them again those who afflicted them, and they returned and wept and cried out to God.
verses.29: And again He saved them by the hand of Samson; and they rested a little while, and then they arose to worship God, despite the evil they had done before.
verses.30: And He also sent against them again other nations who oppressed them; and again they cried out and wept to God, that He might send them help, and He saved them by the hand of Deborah and Barak.
verses.31: And again they lived for a time while they worshipped God; and again they sinned and worshipped God because of the evil they had done before.
verses.32: And He also sent against them other nations who oppressed them; and again He saved them by the hand of Judith; and again they lived for a while, and then arose to worship God as before, despite their evil.
verses.33: And He also raised up for them those who would rule over the nations; and they wept and cried out to God, and He saved them by the hand of Mattathias and his sons, over the corners of the house.
verses.34: For at the head of the shepherds was Alcimus, who came to ravage the land of Judah; and when that shepherd died, his armies were scattered, and they went out and killed the children of Israel until they were consumed and none remained.
verses.35: And after this they rested a little while, and then arose to worship God; and He sent against them nations who ruled over them; and again they cried out and wept to God, and their weeping and their crying were heard, because at all times they worshipped God and kept His commandment.
verses.36: And He delivered them up and carried them away to the land of the Chaldeans, together with their priests.
verses.37: And there also the children of Israel did not forsake the worship of God, though they were transgressors, while they did what was unclean and worshipped idols and mingled with the nations who had carried them away.
verses.38: And God was angry with them there because of their evil, that He might destroy them with wrath; and He cast wrath upon Artaxerxes, king of the Chaldeans, that he should give a thousand talents of silver to the treasurers of the king, and that he should destroy them in one day, by a terrible wonder, so that their seed would not remain in the land of Persia, from India to Ethiopia.
verses.39: And thus he made a written decree by the word of the king, and he gave him the seal that was in his hand, that it should reach every city of Persia.
verses.40: And that they should kill them in one day, as the king commanded them by that which he desired, that they should plunder them; and their plunder of gold and silver he commanded that they should bring to the treasuries of the king.
verses.41: And when the children of Israel heard this, they cried out and wept and lamented before God, and they told Mordecai; and Mordecai also told Esther.
verses.42: And Esther also said, 'Fast and pray and cry out to God, the God of Israel, all the assembly of the children of Israel, wherever you are.'
verses.43: And Mordecai also put on sackcloth and cast ashes upon his head, and they fasted and prayed and repented, wherever the children of Israel were.
verses.44: And Esther also humbled herself greatly; and though she was queen, she put on sackcloth and sprinkled ashes and cast them upon her head, and she did not anoint herself with ointment as the queens of Persia do, and she wept and cried out to God from the depths of her heart, to the God of her fathers.
verses.45: And because of this, God gave her favor before Artaxerxes, king of Persia, and she did a great deed of intercession for the God of her fathers.
verses.46: And the king entered into the banquet that Esther had made, and there God requited Haman according to what he had desired to do to Mordecai, and they hanged him on a high tree.
verses.47: And the king's decree was commanded, that they should leave the Jews alone wherever they were in all their will, and that none should harm them or go against them or touch them or take their goods.
verses.48: And they did not destroy their city, nor plunder the cattle of those who loved them and honored them, wherever they were in all the land of Persia; for thus God had mercy on Israel when they asked and cried out to Him in repentance.
verses.49: And when they worshipped Him, He sent against them the nations who oppressed them; and when they wept and lamented and cried out, that He might send them His help, He saved them from the hand of those who afflicted them.
